svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 270 mm of 22.2 mm (7/8 in) aluminum tube, square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr inside and out and chamfer both outside edges 0.5 mm so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lever and pod clamps slide on without scoring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: through both bar posts, 70 mm above the board, ends standing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm out from each post. From the left: brake lever, pod, brake

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lever, each clamped with its own screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock it with the two M5 grub screws in the posts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the clamps tighten without the bar turning in the posts.
